lastExperiment.validation: Node.js 22 build and verify-generated succeeded in CI on both experiment and revert; deployed source SHA matched in both native reports; native result from real unpacked Chrome Web Store CRX; local npm build not run because local outbound network resolution was unavailable
lastExperiment.notes: No change to generated _headers; native 4,224 -> 4,224, gained 0, lost 0. Reverted to identical original blob 22bcada8dc7f630160d1bf18a5ce7eaf7214e258.
